CONTRACT FOR ADMINISTRATION OF LOCAL SALES AND USE TAX WITHIN THE AREA OF THE METROPOLITAN GOVERNMENT OF NASH- VILLE AND DAVIDSON COUNTY. WHEREAS, Sections 67-3049 through 67-3056, inclusive, of the “Tennessee Code Annotated," provide for the enactment by counties of a tax upon the same privileges sub- Ject to State Taxation under Sections 67-3001 through 67-3046, inclusive, T.C.A., such tax not to exceed one-half (1/2) of the rate of the State tax upon such privileges; and, WHEREAS, The Metropolitan Government of Nashville and Davidson County, hereinafter referred to as "Metropolitan has by appropriate action of its governing body adopted a tax upon such privileges at the rate of one-half {1/2) of the State rate, which action has been approved by the people of the General Services District of the Metropolitan Goverament in @ referendum held for that purpose, the results of which have been duly certified; and, WHEREAS, the ordinance of the Metropolitan Government adopting the said tax for the collection thereof by the Department of Revenue of the State of Tennessee, hereinafter referred to as the “Department", provided such collection has deen determined to be feasible by the Department; and, WHEREAS, the Department is presently satisfied that it is feasible to undertake collection and administration of the said tax within the limitations and conditions in rules and regulations promuigated heretofore by the Department, subject to stipulations hereinafter set forth, WITNESSETH, that the parties signatory hereto, the Commissioner of Revenue of the Department of Revenue of the State of Tennessee, hereinafter referred to as the "Commissioner", ARCHIVE
The Metropolitan Government of Nashville County and all incorporated municipalities within the Metropolitan ‘Government as of the date hereof, do hereby stipulate, con- tract and agree as follows:
1. COLLECTION OF TAX, The Department will collect and be responsible for the administration of the tax imposed by ‘the Metropolitan Government herein referred to with respect to all transactions occurring in its General Services District .to which the State sales or use tax, as the case may be, is applicable and contemporaneously collected by the Department,
2. RULES AND REGULATIONS, All rules and regulations governing the administration and collection of the State and option sales and use tax, as presently existing and as they may be amended by the Commissioner from time to time, are i incorporated into this agreement by reference, and all parties signatory hereto agree to be bound thereby.
3. FES FOR COLLECTION AND ADAINISTRATION, It is agreed that the Department shall retain. from disbursement made as herein provided an amount equal to two and ‘one-half 2-1/2%) per cent of the adjusted gross collections as compen- sation for collecting and administering the local tax referred to herein. The costs incurred by the Department in so doing shall be reviewed at such intervals as are deemed advisable by the Commissioner and, pased upon review so made, the rate of charge may be either increased or decreased so as to pro- vide the required amount to reimburse the Department for its cost incurred in the collection and administration of the tax. Any adjustment, however, whenever made, shall be effective as to succeeding periods only. The Department agrees, however, to apply the same rate of charge to each county or municipality within the State of Tennessee as may by appropriate action adopt a local option sales or use tax which the Department takes to administer. ARCHIVE
4. DISBURSEMENT TO METROPOLITAN GOVERNMENT, The Department shall make to the Metropolitan Government each ‘month a disbursement equal to the total collections, less appropriate adjustment for refunds, and agreed compensation for collection and administration of the tax imposed by the Metropolitan Government. Such disbursement shall be made during the month next succeeding the month in ‘which collection tax is made by the Department. The disbursement thus made monthly to the Metropolitan Government shall be the sole disbursement made by the Department. The Department shall be _ accountable for any error made by it, or its agents, in the disbursement so made to the Metropolitan Government. There shall, however, ‘be absolutely no recourse upon said Department for any errors occasioned by misapprehension as to the location of a taxpayer's place of business subject to the provisions of Sections 67-3011 to 67-3056, inclusive, T.C,A., hereinafter referred to as a or the situs of the exercise. of any taxable privilege, or growing out of any alleged or actual improper distribution or division of the proceeds of said tax effectuated locally between the various governmental entities located within the General Services District of Metropolitan Government.
5. ALLOCATION OF TAX. In order that there may be @ proper distribution of the sales and use tax referred to herein between the Metropolitan Government and the incor- porated municipalities therein, the Department shall maintain sufficient records to show which dealers are liable for the Metropolitan Government sales and use tax. (a) The Department shall take such action as it may deem necessary to determine the geographic location of : the dealers within the General Services District of the Metro- { politan The Metropolitan Government and the incor- porated municipalities therein shall give any reasonable
assistance requested by the Department for this purpose. The results of the determination thus made with respect “to the location of each such taxpayer will then be fur- nished to the Metropolitan Government and the incorporated municipalities therein for their acceptance and confirma- tion, The Metropolitan Government and the incorporated municipalities therein will indicate their acceptance of this information as a basis to establish the aitus for tax collection on their behalf by certification of satisfaction to the Department, Such certified information shall as soon as practicable be incorporated into the records maintained by the Department, and shall provide the basis for enabling the Department to establish the situs from which the tax collections are made. Upon the basis of such information, the Department shall ‘compile a monthly report showing the amount of tax collected within the General Services District of the Metropolitan Government, and furnish the same to the Metropolitan Government for the use of said Metropolitan Government in making such of the:proceeds of the tax within the territory of the Metropolitan Government as may be dictated by appropriate law or contract. The Depart- ment will also furnish a copy of the sald report to each incorporated municipality within the Services Dis- trict of the Metropolitan Government, if and when requested to do so. {b) Pending the determination of the dealers liable for the tax referred to herein and the incorporation of such determination into the records maintained by the Department, the Department's records shall be used as a basis for making the report contemplated in subparagraph (a) hereof, uniess the Metropolitan Government and the incorporated municipalities located therein shall agree for another distribution of the proceeds of the tax, and have furnished a copy of ARCHIVE.
Metropolitan Government. such contract to the Department. It is likewise understood and agreed that there may be some cases in which it will ‘not be feasible or may not be possible to fix a geographic situs to determine the situs where the tax has been collected; these collections shall be reported by the Department on a ratio basis, unless the Metropolitan Government and the incorporated municipalities located therein shall agree otherwise, and have furnished a certified copy of any such contract to the Department. The Metropolitan Government and@ each of the incorporated municipalities within the bor- ders of the Metropolitan Government will arrange, contractu- ally or otherwise, for distribution as between them of the proceeds of the tax herein referred to and a copy of any contractual agreement to that end will be furnished to the Department. It is understood and agreed, however, by all concerned that the Department is to be held Harmless for making any report and distribution pursuant to the terms of this sudsection, and that there shall be no recourse against or any agent thereof, as to any division or distribution of the proceeds of the tax as between govern- mental entities within the General Services District of the With respect to new taxpayers or new places of business within the General Services District of the Metro- politan Government; that is, those commencing to do business subject to sales or use tax from and after the effective date hereof, the Department shall, for the purpose of the reports provided for in subparagraph (a) hereof, conclusively deem i the situs of taxable transactions to be the location of a tax- payer's place of business as reflected in the records main- i tained by the Department for the purposes of the State sales : and use tax, The Department shall, upon request, furnish to any party hereto, annually, listings of new businesses and locations as shown by the said records, ARCHIVE
In the event of the surrender of its charter by any municipality within the General Services District of “the Metropolitan Government from and after the effective date of this a certification of this fact shail be furnished to the Department by the Metropolitan Govern- ment. Until such certification 4s furnished, the Department shall, for the purposes of the reports provided for in sub- paragraph (a) hereof, conclusively deom the aitus of the tax transactions to be the location of the place of business as reflected in the records maintained by the De- partment for purposes of the State sales and use tax, and there shall be no recourse therefor against the Department, or any thereof.
6. CONCURRENCE BY MUNICIPALITIES. It is under~ stood that this agreement shall be binding upon,the Depart- ment only upon the concurrence in same by each incorporated municipality within the General Services District of the “Metropolitan Government, as evidenced by the signatures of - their highest executive officers. 7» CANCELLATION OF CONTRACT. It is understood and agreed that this contract may be cancelled on the ocour- rence of eny one of the following events: (2) The Department or the Metropolitan Govern- ment may give the other party and to each incorporated munic- ipality within the General Services District of the Metro- . politan Government six notice that it no donger desires the agreement to be effective. (>) The Department shail have the right to cancel this agreement immediately upon any breach by the Metropolitan of of this agreement, or of any pro- vision contained in the statute, or ordinance of adoption, rules and regulations pertaining thereto, or the terms of this agreement. In the event of such cancellation by the Department, ARCHIVE
the Department's obligation shall extend only’ to make col- lection of the local tax for the remainder of the current “nonth, and make to the Metropolitan Government a proper distribution with respect to such Collection. {¢) The ordinance imposing the local sales or use tax shall be repealed, as provided for in Section 67-3055, &. EFFECTIVE DATE. This agreement shall be effec- tive as of the first day of October, 1968, and 419 in lieu of the contract entered into between the of Revenue of the Department of Revenue, the Metropolitan Government end all incorporated municipalities within the General Services District of the Metropolitan Government, on the 8th day of July, 1965, which provides for the administration of the local sales tax levied at the rate of one-third (1/3) of the State rate.
